niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces with generous spacing, lower apparent density, and clearly grouped content. They like strong visual hierarchy with centered or tightly focused compositions, prominent headings or hero elements, and fewer competing elements at once. They favor rounded, card-based components with softer shapes and polished visual treatment. Their color preferences are context-dependent but consistently lean toward more intentional, expressive palettes over flat generic ones: warm or vivid accents, cohesive branding, and stronger contrast when used in a controlled way. They also prefer layouts that keep attention on the primary task, use clear section separation, and present information in structured chunks rather than dense continuous text or mixed utility blocks.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers generous padding, larger gaps between sections, spacious layouts, and interfaces that feel less cramped.

Prefers strong focal structure such as prominent headlines or hero elements, centered/tightly grouped compositions, and clear emphasis over layouts where attention is split across many competing elements.
Prefers fewer visible items at once, chunked presentation, simplified overviews, and separated sections instead of dense lists, continuous text, or highly packed dashboards.
Prefers clearly separated, labeled sections and unified grouping of related inputs or content rather than mixed blocks or fragmented fields.
Prefers deliberate, polished color systems with warm or vivid accents, cohesive branding, and stronger visual identity over generic or less intentional palettes.
Prefers rounded rectangles, pill-like or heavily rounded components, card-based panels, and an overall softer, friendlier visual feel.
Prefers layouts that keep focus on the main task or message, reduce secondary distractions, and use cleaner compositions with fewer unnecessary controls or promotional elements.
